title: What mass spectrometry measures
summary: From molecules to ions to evidence: understand what a mass spectrum can—and cannot—tell you.
zh_summary: 从分子到离子，再到证据：理解质谱能够回答和无法单独回答的问题。

title: m/z, charge & isotopes
summary: Calculate charged-ion masses and build an isotope distribution, then connect both to measurement quality.
zh_summary: 计算带电离子的质量并构建同位素分布，再将二者与测量质量联系起来。

title: How molecules become ions
summary: Compare ESI, MALDI, EI, and APCI by the chemistry they enable—not by a universal ranking.
zh_summary: 根据电离过程与适用化学性质比较 ESI、MALDI、EI 和 APCI。

title: Mass analyzers & resolution
summary: Follow quadrupole filtering, TOF timing, ion trapping, and frequency measurement, then compare resolution and accuracy.
zh_summary: 理解四极杆过滤、TOF 计时、离子俘获与频率测量，再比较分辨本领与准确度。

title: Fragmentation & tandem MS
summary: Trace precursor isolation, compare activation methods, and interpret charge-aware product and neutral-loss evidence.
zh_summary: 跟踪前体隔离、比较活化方法，并结合电荷解释产物与中性丢失证据。

title: Read a spectrum step by step
summary: Read an annotated simulated spectrum: infer charge, inspect isotope ratios, and separate narrow peaks from accurate masses.
zh_summary: 解读带注释的模拟谱图：推断电荷、检查同位素比值，并区分窄峰与准确的质量测量。

title: Acquisition: full scan, DDA, DIA & targeted
zh_title: 采集：全扫描、DDA、DIA 与靶向
summary: Connect precursor selection, isolation windows, and chromatographic sampling to the evidence recorded by full scan, DDA, DIA, and targeted methods.
zh_summary: 把前体选择、隔离窗口与色谱采样联系起来，理解全扫描、DDA、DIA 和靶向方法保留的证据。

title: From raw data to reliable results
zh_title: 从原始数据到可靠结果
summary: Follow the evidence from spectral peaks to features, identity, and quantity, with explicit assumptions for error control, normalization, missing data, and study design.
zh_summary: 沿谱峰、特征、身份到定量追踪证据，明确错误控制、归一化、缺失数据和实验设计中的假设。

title: Sample preparation & recovery
summary: Choose a preparation strategy and separate analyte loss, matrix-dependent response, and overall process response using matched comparisons.
zh_summary: 选择前处理策略，并用匹配比较区分分析物损失、基质相关响应与总过程响应。

title: Liquid chromatography for MS
zh_title: 面向质谱的液相色谱分离
summary: Connect retention, separation mode, gradient delivery, peak shape, and acquisition timing to the evidence in an LC-MS trace.
zh_summary: 把保留、分离模式、梯度输送、峰形与采集时序联系起来，理解 LC-MS 轨迹中的证据。

title: Blanks, carryover & contamination
summary: Choose informative blanks, use sequence history to investigate unexpected signals, and interpret carryover percentages with explicit denominators.
zh_summary: 选择有信息价值的空白，利用序列历史调查意外信号，并明确分母来解释残留百分比。

title: Quantitative measurement & calibration
summary: Turn response into concentration with a defined calibration model, suitable standards, validated limits, and explicit reporting units.
zh_summary: 通过明确的校准模型、适当标准、已验证的限值及清楚的报告单位，将响应转换为浓度。

title: Experimental design & replication
summary: Define independent units, preserve pairing, balance batches, and plan replication around the comparison you want to make.
zh_summary: 定义独立单位、保留配对、平衡批次，并围绕预期比较规划重复。

title: QC, batch effects & normalization
zh_title: 质控、批次效应与归一化
summary: Use controls to diagnose drift, test correction assumptions, and distinguish a cleaner matrix from a more defensible measurement.
zh_summary: 利用质控诊断漂移、检验校正假设，并区分更整齐的数据矩阵与更有依据的测量。

title: Bottom-up proteomics: from sample to protein evidence
zh_title: 自下而上蛋白质组学：从样本到蛋白质证据
summary: Follow preparation, digestion, measurement, identification, and quantification while preserving the limits of peptide evidence.
zh_summary: 沿制备、酶解、测量、鉴定和定量追踪证据，同时保留肽段证据的解释边界。

title: Peptide identification and protein inference
zh_title: 肽段鉴定与蛋白质推断
summary: Separate scores, error levels, shared-peptide mappings, protein groups, and sequence coverage using explicit teaching examples.
zh_summary: 通过明确的教学例子区分分数、错误层级、共享肽段映射、蛋白质分组和序列覆盖率。

title: PTM analysis and site localization
zh_title: 翻译后修饰分析与位点定位
summary: Distinguish mass changes, modified peptides, localized sites, and occupancy with charge-aware and positional examples.
zh_summary: 通过考虑电荷和修饰位置的例子，区分质量变化、修饰肽段、已定位位点和占有率。

title: Small-molecule annotation: from features to identity
zh_title: 小分子注释：从特征到身份
summary: Build ion, formula, and structure hypotheses, compare reference evidence, and report what remains unresolved.
zh_summary: 建立离子、分子式和结构假设，比较参考证据，并报告尚未解决的问题。

title: Lipidomics: match structural detail to evidence
zh_title: 脂质组学：让结构细节与证据相匹配
summary: Distinguish lipid class, sum composition, chains, sn positions, and double-bond evidence without overnaming a signal.
zh_summary: 区分脂质类别、总组成、链、sn 位置和双键证据，避免给信号赋予过度具体的名称。

title: Ion mobility and collision cross section
summary: Separate measured mobility coordinates from derived CCS and compare ions with explicit gas, temperature, and calibration context.
zh_summary: 区分实测淌度坐标与推导的 CCS，在明确气体、温度和校准背景下比较离子。
